- Isolate / take offline the host or service behind `staged-on-public-service`.
- Pull full process, network, and filesystem forensic images from that host before remediation.
- Verify the host's system clock and the log-shipper's timestamp handling (root cause of the malformed hours).
- Search adjacent logs (firewall, DNS, proxy, EDR) for the same source to locate any payload/exfil traffic that did not make it into `c2.log`.
- Confirm whether `staged-on-public-service` maps to a known internal asset or is attacker-controlled naming.
